definition.title: Evaluate and appoint participants
definition.subtitle: Learn, understand, and use a Mandarin pattern.
definition.context: Use the introduced pattern in a bounded sentence. Other wording may be valid Chinese; this task checks this pattern and these words.

blocks.text: The participant after a causing verb performs the following action or experiences the stated condition. 让 can convey a request, but an event can also cause a person to feel or act a certain way without anyone giving an instruction. 使 explicitly describes causation; it does not replace every request with 让. Appointment frames put the selected person before the role they take. A praise or criticism verb may take person plus action as its object.

examples.meaning: Everyone selects him to be the teacher.
The teacher praises him for studying conscientiously.
The teacher criticizes him for talking in class.

examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì shǐ wǒ gāoxìng 。
